summary: Chart legend: a color key with dash pattern/marker or texture, an optional value, and, if needed, buttons to show/hide series.
whenToUse: Already included in LineChart, BarChart, and DonutChart; use it on its own for custom visualizations that use the same data colors.
Filtering visible series with toggle buttons (isToggleable).
whenNotToUse: For complex filters or multi-selection across many items: use Checkbox or a ToggleButtonGroup.
To label a single value: write the text directly.

props.name: items
props.description: Items; colorIndex (0-based) selects the --dc-color-data-N color, dash pattern, marker, and texture.

props.name: swatch
props.description: Line key with marker (line charts) or square with texture (bars, slices).

props.name: isToggleable
props.description: Each item becomes a <button> with aria-pressed (pressed = series visible).

props.name: hiddenItems / defaultHiddenItems
props.description: Ids of the hidden items (controlled / uncontrolled).

inherits: HTML attributes of <ul>; the ref points to the list.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between the legend buttons (only with isToggleable).

accessibility: Semantic <ul>/<li> list; the graphic keys are decorative (aria-hidden) and the name is the item text.
Toggles are real <button> elements with aria-pressed; the hidden state is visible without color too (strikethrough text, dashed border, dimmed key).
Button targets ≥ 24 px (density sm control height).
responsive: Items wrap and long labels break across lines.
commonMistakes: Using colorIndex values different from those of the associated chart: the legend no longer matches the data.
Hiding all series without an obvious way to restore them.
limits: aria-pressed means "series visible": the meaning is implied by the chart context, not announced with dedicated text.
